style: Antique nautical copperplate engraving, iron-gall ink and vellum, transparent PNG

assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: a single transparent PNG ship sprite for the nautical game The Monstrous Sea, not a poster or UI mockup.
Primary request: an exceptionally convincing antique copperplate / woodcut engraving of one heavy three-masted merchant freighter, as if individually drawn by an experienced 18th-century nautical illustrator. Truly transparent background, no paper rectangle.
Subject: broad deep-draft wooden cargo hull, two believable decks, a high sterncastle at LEFT, sharp bow and bowsprit at RIGHT. Exactly THREE tall wooden masts physically planted into that hull, full square-rigged cream canvas, clear connected yards and shrouds, believable taut rigging with sparse readable ropes. Slight starboard broadside perspective so the hull length and all three distinct masts read clearly. Heavy stable cargo vessel, not an ornate warship.
Style/medium: hand-pulled ink engraving with sensitive irregular tapered pen lines, natural variations in line density, controlled curved cross-hatching following timber and canvas forms, a few broken strokes and small human imperfections. Anatomically and mechanically coherent draftsmanship. Strong silhouette, confident dark hull shadows, broad light canvas areas. Medium detail optimized for display around 250 pixels wide. Quiet authentic maritime chart marginal illustration, not simplified vector clip art.
Color palette: iron-gall ink #1B1612 predominates; sail interiors warm vellum #F4ECD8, tiny dark-parchment #D5C4A1 shadow washes. At most one tiny faded crimson #8C2D19 pennant and subtle brass #C59B27 stern trim. Flat printed pigments, no gradients or glossy rendering.
Composition: isolated entire ship, centered on a square canvas, filling approximately 86% of width and 80% of height, with all bow, spars and mast tips inside generous clean margins. Hull baseline around 80% of canvas height. Minimal tiny attached ink waterline strokes only immediately beneath keel. Negative space elsewhere must have real alpha transparency.
Constraints: all masts join deck; sails attach to their yards; no detached architecture, no invented excess masts. No title, lettering, signature, frame, surrounding scenery, horizon, background parchment, checkerboard pattern, dramatic sunlight, glow, digital-painting softness, photorealistic/3D materials, symmetrical ornament, cartoon faces, airbrushed shading, saturated colors. Crisp readable engraved forms rather than indiscriminate micro-detail.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one transparent PNG kraken sprite for the nautical game The Monstrous Sea.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the heavy freighter engraving. Create a new creature, do not include or redraw the ship. Match its restrained dark-brown ink, cream interiors, confident tapered engraved strokes and hand-pulled print character.
Primary request: a colossal unsettling Kraken from the margin of an eighteenth-century sea chart, drawn by the same skilled human engraver as the reference ship. Genuine transparent background.
Subject: biologically convincing ancient octopus-like sea monster, large asymmetric sack-like mantle and two small deep-set watchful predatory eyes. No human facial expression. Eight principal thick organic muscular arms with clearly connected roots and tapered curling tips; visible double rows of suckers follow arm undersides. Secondary coils behind the main arms suggest its immense scale. Natural varied poses and overlaps, individually readable major arms rather than a tangled knot. Broad threatening silhouette, the upper-left arm reaches toward its unseen opponent on the LEFT. Entire creature visible.
Style/medium: mature antique nautical copperplate engraving; curved contour-following cross-hatching, spare stippling, irregular organic line-weight and slight imperfect ink impressions. Darker underside hatching and broad light parchment-colored body surfaces, matching the ship's balance of dark shadow and cream highlight. Quiet physical menace, not a fantasy concept-art demon. Medium detail with strong silhouette readable around 260px wide.
Color palette: primarily iron-gall ink #1B1612, vellum #F4ECD8 body interiors, subtle dark-parchment #D5C4A1 shadow tint. Tiny muted crimson #8C2D19 eye glints at most. Flat printed pigments, no glow, no glossy rendering.
Composition: centered cutout on square canvas, occupies about 80% width and 80% height with a clear 8–10% transparent margin around EVERY arm tip. Heavier main body in upper middle, sinuous coils widening below. A few very short sea-foam ink strokes attached to the lower arms are acceptable, nothing else.
Constraints: coherent soft cephalopod anatomy, distinct connected arms and tapered tips, intentional human draftsmanship. No paper/background rectangle, checkerboard pattern, frame, lettering, signature, ship, horizon, scenery, teeth, dragon horns, anthropomorphic eyebrows, cartoon face, ornamental symmetry, cinematic lighting, airbrush, vibrant colors, photoreal skin or 3D rendering.

integration: Freighter selection/port/rest views and Flame combat; Kraken combat; other combatants retain existing art.
limitation: The Kraken raster is a fixed illustration. Tentacle counts remain live in the HUD, with existing sever notifications and a brief damage tint; individual illustrated arms are not removed.
